title: Senior Ruby Backend Engineer
text:
Senior Ruby Backend Engineer
FICTIONAL JOB DESCRIPTION — NOT AN OPEN VACANCY

ROLE PURPOSE
Maintain subscription and billing services for a fictional developer-tools product. Work with a product owner and support team to make changes understandable and recoverable. The position focuses on correctness and predictable operational behavior in a shared application rather than on accumulating technology keywords.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
- Build transactional Ruby on Rails backend services.
- Design PostgreSQL schemas and investigate SQL query behavior.
- Write automated regression tests for backend failure paths.
- Diagnose and verify application performance improvements.
- Review code for correctness and maintainability.
- Collaborate through clear asynchronous technical communication.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
- Use Redis caching or background job processing in an implemented project.
- Implement a Go service beyond introductory coursework.

DELIVERY EXPECTATIONS
Explain an implementation decision, show how a failure was investigated, and describe how another colleague could maintain the result. Work in small reviewed increments, document assumptions and raise uncertainty early. Evidence may come from employment or clearly identified projects; a skills list alone does not establish delivered work.

WORKING CONDITIONS
This fictional role uses asynchronous collaboration. Location, work authorization, compensation and availability are unspecified and must not be inferred from a technical match score.

title: Application Security Engineer
